name: ProofLaunch

routes.purpose: Open the current local campaign-operations priority queue.
Inspect required product evidence and local file metadata.
Record a synthetic local campaign brief without approving claims.
Inspect runtime facts and demonstrate truthful waiting and recovery states.
Inspect audit failure, bounded repair review, and safe recovery states.
Review release blockers without creating or publishing an export.
Inspect the shared strategy spine and nine channel-specific expression contracts.
Inspect a pre-registered single-variable experiment object and its release gates.
Inspect fatigue, outcome, holdout, and audience-learning decision boundaries.
Inspect the generated visual source, its lineage, and the truth boundary around the 8K delivery master.
Inspect one tenant-scoped lifecycle decision record from strategy through production, approval, aggregate effect, unit economics, promoted memory, and the next bounded action.
Run a tenant-isolated cloud-frontier strategy-to-last-mile mission with context-selected professional skills, platform-native production and fail-closed release audit.
Create a typed, approval-gated synthetic mechanical run.
Inspect externally observable run events without hidden reasoning.
Inspect bounded capabilities, permissions, and authoritative ownership.
Inspect separated memory classes and approval requirements.
Inspect evidence-labeled model cards and evaluation records.
Distinguish a training plan from observed jobs, checkpoints, and traces.
Inspect independent claim, identity, policy, and provenance gates.
Enter the bounded, reversible repair-review workflow.
Record an explicit human decision at the bundle boundary.
Inspect the exact twelve-slot image matrix without invented assets.
Inspect three video-role slots without invented encodes.
Inspect a non-publishable landing-page channel frame.
Inspect a send-disabled lifecycle email frame.
Download the approved deterministic evidence bundle.
Inspect measured-only control-plane and Radeon telemetry status.
Inspect the tenant, principal, role, and object-authorization contract.
Inspect policy precedence, control families, conflicts, and exceptions.
Inspect connector scopes, health, action modes, and revocation boundaries.
Inspect the modeled runtime topology, objectives, and truthful absence of production telemetry.
Inspect source, derived, generated, and operational data lifecycle boundaries.
Index supplied dataset metadata.
Inspect the supplied dataset record and its access boundary.
Inspect the unverified local LoRA output path named by the source.
Explain the absent repository connection.
Explain the source-declared non-use of Hugging Face login and Hub access.
Record a source-mentioned package mirror without making a request.
Index supplied model metadata.
Inspect the supplied model record and inference boundary.
Expose the missing production specification PDF requirement.
Explain the supplied ROCm statement and browser verification boundary.
Expose the supplied reproducibility seed without claiming a reproduced run.
Explain how the supplied specification remains untrusted product data.
Record the source-mentioned wheel index without installing it.
Explain the self-contained external-web boundary.

evidence: The supplied contract identifies campaign operators, owner-reviewers, and technical qualifiers at small ecommerce or hardware organizations.
The workflow centers evidence custody, approval, audit, repair, and release qualification.

copyPolicy.audienceDescription: Campaign operators, owner-reviewers, and technical qualifiers.
copyPolicy.tone: Calm, operational, evidence-led, and explicit about unavailable capabilities.
copyPolicy.claimBoundary: State supplied facts, local interface behavior, and unresolved blockers only; do not imply model execution, successful audit, provenance validation, publication, market rank, or comparative superiority.

visualModes.desktop: An executive-grade three-pane GTM mission control with a cinematic generated atmosphere, operational task canvas, product-layer rail, and source-aligned inspector.
visualModes.mobile: A portrait-first priority queue and governed task flow with five reachable stage destinations, source inspector continuity, safe-area spacing, and stacked action controls; desktop layers recompose instead of shrinking.

designSignature.heroComposition: Operational mission object and native actions beside a GPT-generated nine-channel intelligence constellation
designSignature.typographyCharacter: Editorial display serif for product moments, legible grotesk for operations, and monospace for evidence identifiers
designSignature.mobileComposition: A priority queue opens accordion task steps and a persistent approve, repair, or export dock

designReferencePlan.rationale: The contract declares no local design references, so the direction is derived from the supplied product workflow, audience, evidence obligations, and controlled art-direction grammar without borrowing third-party trade dress.

designSystemPlan.rationale: The contract declares no owner-supplied local JSON design systems. The implementation should use a replaceable local semantic role system and native controls without claiming, fetching, or installing an external component system.

artDirection.visualThesis: A dark executive mission-control surface makes one governed campaign object, its nine channel expressions, and its human decision gates immediately inspectable.
artDirection.brandSignal: Disciplined intelligence expressed through mineral surfaces, luminous topology, source custody, restrained state colors, and a persistent decision object.
artDirection.motionThesis: Intensity 2/10. Only transform and opacity animate for rail progress, inspector continuity, accordion expansion, and immediate waiting-to-result feedback; claims, metrics, hashes, product geometry, focus, and error meaning never animate. Reduced motion removes CSS transitions and keyframes and swaps states in place.
differentiationAxes: The first surface is the working five-stage state machine rather than a centered marketing promise.
One active task canvas replaces a mosaic of interchangeable KPI cards.
Every artifact drills into source, approval, runtime, audit, and repair custody in one inspector.
Safety color is reserved for pass, waiting, warning, and blocked consequences rather than brand decoration.
The role pathways change information priority without inventing separate products or pricing tiers.
Mobile converts the workflow rail into an accordion task path and priority queue rather than a horizontally scrolling desktop navigation.
The capability diagram is generated from supplied workflow stages and states, so it does not depend on unsupplied photography or external brand artwork.

categoryExperiencePlan.rationale: The selected profiles jointly require an inspectable agent lifecycle, a real operational task surface, explicit inputs and provenance, human control, permission clarity, waiting and failure states, and audit recovery. These are implemented as local deterministic experience contracts, not as claims of a working model or external action.

agentRunLifecycle.decision: Represent queued, running, waiting, failed, repaired, passed, and blocked as explicit finite local states without implying a real model run.
agentRunLifecycle.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-agentic-workspace profile.
agentRunLifecycle.verification: Manual review: /workspace/create and /workspace/verify state controls expose every lifecycle label and never auto-complete an unavailable process.

humanControlPoint.decision: Require explicit user confirmation before claim approval, bounded repair, and export-state changes.
humanControlPoint.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-agentic-workspace profile.
humanControlPoint.verification: Manual interaction: /workspace/evidence approve, /workspace/verify repair, and /workspace/export review each disclose actor, consequence, and cancel path.

toolTransparency.decision: Show action, selected semantic input, known model/runtime identifiers, seed, hash, time, and source link; display unknown facts as unresolved.
toolTransparency.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-agentic-workspace profile.
toolTransparency.verification: Manual review: /workspace/create inspector and /workspace/export evidence inventory distinguish known, required, waiting, and unavailable tool facts.

failureRecovery.decision: Each failure names the artifact, gate, reason, prior action, repair allowance, and next safe option; unresolved failures block export.
failureRecovery.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-agentic-workspace and b2b-ai-tool profile.
failureRecovery.verification: Interaction test: enter failed state on /workspace/verify, recover to the prior safe state, and confirm the blocked reason remains visible in /workspace/export.

taskSurface.decision: Treat Evidence, Brief, Create, Verify & Repair, and Export as continuous states of one job rather than marketing feature cards.
taskSurface.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-saas-workspace profile.
taskSurface.verification: Route walkthrough: navigate /workspace/evidence through /workspace/export while the same job capsule and stage state persist.

informationDensity.decision: Use compact, scan-first operational density with progressive disclosure for technical telemetry and stacked label-value rows on narrow screens.
informationDensity.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-saas-workspace profile.
informationDensity.verification: Manual review task: compare a claim list, audit detail, and runtime drawer at desktop and 320 CSS-pixel width without losing critical text.

permissionBoundary.decision: Keep actor, permitted action, consequence, unavailable actions, and local prototype limits explicit at every consequential control.
permissionBoundary.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-saas-workspace profile.
permissionBoundary.verification: Manual review: attempt claim approval, repair, and export-state transitions and confirm permission/consequence copy is adjacent to each control.

auditability.decision: Maintain a visible append-only local decision trail connecting source, approval, audit, repair, and export status without claiming production non-repudiation.
auditability.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-saas-workspace profile.
auditability.verification: Interaction test: perform local demo transitions and inspect ordered entries on /workspace/verify and /workspace/export.

inputContext.decision: Expose only declared file requirements, selected local file metadata, source spans when actually supplied, and the selected market/platform/objective.
inputContext.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-ai-tool profile.
inputContext.verification: Manual review: /workspace/evidence shows an honest empty state before file selection and never invents PDF text, Claim IDs, or image evidence.

outputProvenance.decision: Separate factual audit status from provenance status and keep C2PA unavailable until verifiable evidence exists.
outputProvenance.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-ai-tool profile.
outputProvenance.verification: Manual review: /workspace/export displays factual gate and provenance rows independently, with missing C2PA proof unresolved.

streamingOrWaitingState.decision: Use an announced waiting state for unavailable or long-running product actions; never simulate tokens, progress, or completion from a nonexistent backend.
streamingOrWaitingState.rationale: Required by the selected b2b-ai-tool profile.
streamingOrWaitingState.verification: Interaction test: activate a demo processing action and verify immediate Waiting feedback, cancel/safe-leave behavior, and no fabricated success artifact.

productCategoryIntelligence.primaryJob: Turn product evidence into a reviewed, repairable, and traceable campaign pack without losing the source of each claim or the identity of the supplied product.

endUsers: Campaign and GTM operators at cross-border ecommerce or hardware small businesses
Owner-operators reviewing claims and final campaign assets
economicBuyers: Marketing or growth leads accountable for campaign delivery and risk
admins: Technical maintainers responsible for the local Radeon and ROCm environment, access boundary, and reproducible setup
operators: Users who ingest product evidence, approve claims, inspect audit failures, authorize repairs, and export Campaign Packs

comparisonSet: Manual creative production followed by a separate compliance review
General-purpose image generation paired with spreadsheet-based claim tracking
Agency production workflows that use separate audit and provenance tools

appleAppStore.rationale: The declared target is iOS-class mobile web, and the contract explicitly excludes native iOS parity, App Store upload, and App Store approval.

googlePlay.rationale: The supplied specification defines a web workspace and does not define an Android application, Google Play submission, or native mobile product.

productHunt.rationale: The supplied specification defines a local competition prototype and contains no Product Hunt launch, listing, or approved discovery-category decision; this brief does not infer one.

g2.rationale: The supplied specification contains no commercial G2 listing, verified G2 category, or production procurement offering; local routing anchors are experience guidance and are not a market-placement claim.

design: Use an evidence-first, medium-high-density operational workspace rather than a marketing-only dashboard.
Make stage, source, status, consequence, and the next safe action visually dominant.
Keep technical telemetry progressively disclosed so campaign reviewers can focus on decision-relevant evidence.
Preserve the split preview and evidence inspector relationship at desktop widths and recompose it into an inspectable queue-detail flow on mobile.
interaction: Expose Evidence, Brief, Create, Verify & Repair, and Export as a continuous stateful workflow.
Require explicit claim approval and a human control point before consequential repair or export actions.
Show queued, running, waiting, failed, repaired, passed, and blocked states with immediate feedback and recovery paths.
On mobile, preserve priority, consequence, permission clarity, audit context, safe takeover, and gesture alternatives instead of shrinking a desktop table.
businessMetrics: Time from source upload to an audited export decision
Share of displayed campaign copy linked to approved Claim IDs
Detection and successful bounded repair rate by declared audit class
End-to-end success rate across fixed regression samples
Completeness of the reproducibility and provenance evidence pack

confidence.rationale: B2B work management is the closest supplied taxonomy candidate because the product is a staged operational workflow with review, approval, audit, repair, and handoff. Security and developer-tool signals are supporting concerns, while the product does not perform coding-agent work. The deterministic candidates do not include a campaign-operations category, so the selection is a routing fit rather than a market-placement claim.
evidenceRefs: normalized-spec.md — accepted-research-synthesis.md design-experience and product-market sections
contract.json — categoryIntelligence candidates and experience profiles

mobileExperiencePlan.rationale: The workbench must recompose for phone use around priority, consequence, permission, evidence, and recovery while remaining a web experience with no native-app claims.

customGestures.purpose: Compare the declared before and after repair surfaces when real paired evidence exists.
customGestures.alternative: Labeled Before and After segmented buttons plus an adjacent Difference summary.
customGestures.feedback: The selected state label, pressed state, and comparison heading update immediately; no gesture is required to inspect the difference.

adaptation.safeArea: Inset fixed navigation, inspector sheets, notices, and the action dock with env(safe-area-inset-*).
adaptation.dynamicViewport: Use dynamic viewport units and content-driven minimum heights; avoid fixed-height traps under browser chrome.
adaptation.portraitLandscape: Portrait uses queue-to-task-to-sheet order; landscape may use task plus inspector without reducing touch targets.
adaptation.keyboardAvoidance: Focused fields, validation messages, submit, and cancel remain visible above the on-screen keyboard and the dock may reflow into content.
adaptation.localization: Use operational English; allow wrapping and expansion for future reviewed localization, preserve source numbers and units, and do not claim complete Japanese or German localization.

stateRecovery.loading: Show an announced bounded loading or waiting label without simulated completion.
stateRecovery.empty: Explain required inputs and the next permitted action without placeholder evidence.
stateRecovery.error: Name the affected item, reason, retained state, and retry or safe-exit option.
stateRecovery.offline: Keep the static shell and locally held state usable; show that external processing is not part of this build.
stateRecovery.resume: Restore the last safe stage, active item, inspector target, approved local state, and remaining repair allowance without repeating a consequential action.

primaryTaskFocus.decision: Lead with current priority, consequence, and one next safe action.
primaryTaskFocus.rationale: The selected profile requires a priority-first operational surface.
primaryTaskFocus.verification: Manual review: the first mobile viewport of /workspace/evidence or the current workspace route exposes stage, consequence, and next action.

reachability.decision: Place the one current consequential action in a safe-area-aware bottom dock with a 44 px minimum target.
reachability.rationale: Primary actions must remain operable one-handed without hiding consequences.
reachability.verification: Automated check: all dock controls have a computed minimum inline/block target of at least 44 CSS pixels.

navigationContinuity.decision: Preserve the same job capsule, active stage, selected item, and focus return target across queue, detail, inspector, and back navigation.
navigationContinuity.rationale: Operational review loses trust if context resets between mobile surfaces.
verification: Interaction test: open an evidence item from the queue, inspect it, return, and confirm selection and scroll context.
Manual screen-reader review: back navigation announces the restored queue heading.

gestureAlternatives.decision: Provide labeled buttons or step controls for every swipe, drag, crop, pan, or comparison interaction.
gestureAlternatives.rationale: No approval, repair, evidence inspection, or recovery may depend on gesture precision.
gestureAlternatives.verification: Manual review: complete the before/after comparison and all consequential actions without gestures or pointer drag.

immediateFeedback.decision: Return visible and announced press feedback within 500 ms and then expose waiting, success, failure, or blocked status.
immediateFeedback.rationale: Users need prompt acknowledgement without fabricated processing progress.
immediateFeedback.verification: Automated interaction timing check: primary controls change pressed/status state within 500 ms.

safeAreaAndViewport.decision: Use safe-area insets and dynamic viewport sizing for fixed navigation, sheets, notices, and the action dock.
safeAreaAndViewport.rationale: Mobile browser chrome and device cutouts must not obscure controls or evidence.
verification: Automated viewport review at portrait and landscape sizes.
Manual iOS-class browser review with dynamic chrome and keyboard visible.

textAndAppearanceAdaptation.decision: Support 200% text reflow, light and dark schemes, and increased-contrast roles without truncating claims or failure reasons.
textAndAppearanceAdaptation.rationale: Dense evidence remains usable only if critical text and status survive system adaptation.
textAndAppearanceAdaptation.verification: Manual review at 200% text size, light, dark, and increased-contrast settings.

keyboardAndInput.decision: Keep focus order, focused fields, validation, submit, and cancel visible with hardware or on-screen keyboards.
keyboardAndInput.rationale: Touch is primary but keyboard and assistive-technology parity are required.
keyboardAndInput.verification: Manual review: complete file metadata, selection, confirmation, and recovery flows with keyboard and screen reader.

motionAccessibility.decision: Use only short transform/opacity state transitions; make them interruptible and remove them under reduced motion.
motionAccessibility.rationale: Motion must explain state and never become a barrier or ambient effect.
motionAccessibility.verification: Automated CSS check plus manual prefers-reduced-motion review confirms zero transitions and keyframes in the reduced mode.

stateRecovery.decision: Retain the last safe route and local state and never replay a consequential action after interruption.
stateRecovery.rationale: The operational profile requires safe takeover and resume across backgrounding, rotation, or navigation interruption.
stateRecovery.verification: Interaction test: interrupt after a waiting or confirmation state, reload, and confirm return to the last safe non-committed state.

mobilePriorityQueue.decision: Open on the current job or honest empty priority queue and show blocked count, stage, consequence, and next action as text.
mobilePriorityQueue.rationale: The selected mobile-operational-workspace profile names a queue or inspectable task as the first surface.
mobilePriorityQueue.verification: Manual review: the mobile entry surface is a priority queue, not a compressed desktop table or dashboard card mosaic.

permissionAndConsequence.decision: Name the actor, allowed action, affected artifact, consequence, and reversibility beside approval, repair, and export controls.
permissionAndConsequence.rationale: Consequential operations require clarity before commitment.
permissionAndConsequence.verification: Manual review task: inspect all three consequential control points and confirm permission and consequence are visible before activation.

auditAndRecovery.decision: Keep source, history, failed gate, reason, repair allowance, and next safe recovery one sheet or step away.
auditAndRecovery.rationale: The selected profile prioritizes inspectability, audit, and safe recovery.
auditAndRecovery.verification: Interaction test: open a failed verify item, inspect its source and history, and recover or remain explicitly blocked without losing context.

automated: Check destination count is one to five, touch targets are at least 44 px, and transitions do not exceed 550 ms.
Check reduced-motion CSS removes transitions and keyframes and that status names remain in the accessibility tree.
Check 320, 390, 768, and landscape viewport layouts for horizontal overflow and obscured fixed controls.
Check duplicate activation guards and resume logic do not repeat consequential transitions.
manual: Walk queue, detail, evidence, approval, result, failure, and recovery with touch, keyboard, and a screen reader.
Review portrait and landscape with browser chrome, safe areas, on-screen keyboard, 200% text, light, dark, and increased contrast.
Confirm every custom gesture has a labeled alternative and every unavailable real capability remains honest.

mobileDesignExcellencePlan.rationale: Apply the run’s locally derived mobile-web critique standard to make the ProofLaunch operational workflow purposeful, controllable, inclusive, coherent, and truthful without implying an Apple award, native parity, or comparative superiority.

purpose.decision: Make the evidence-to-safe-decision task and current gate explicit on every mobile surface.
purpose.rationale: Purpose is the strongest organizing principle for a dense operational workflow.
verification: Review the first viewport and each workspace route for task, consequence, and one next safe action.

agency.decision: Expose cancel, back, inspect, confirm, retry, and safe-leave controls while retaining context.
agency.rationale: Users must be able to correct, take over, or stop bounded AI-like work.
verification: Complete approval, waiting, failure, and recovery flows without a hidden or forced action.

responsibility.decision: Separate supplied fact, required proof, simulated UI state, provenance status, and unresolved risk.
responsibility.rationale: The product handles publishing risk and must not overstate what a static prototype proves.
verification: Review claim, runtime, audit, and export copy for explicit evidence status and boundaries.

familiarity.decision: Use semantic web controls and recognizable queue, detail, sheet, step, status, and confirmation patterns.
familiarity.rationale: Familiar controls reduce learning cost without copying another product’s trade dress.
verification: Keyboard and screen-reader review of navigation, disclosure, dialog, and table/list patterns.

flexibility.decision: Support touch, keyboard, assistive technology, portrait, landscape, light, dark, contrast, and 200% text.
flexibility.rationale: The same operational decisions must remain available across inputs and adaptations.
verification: Run the full manual adaptation matrix and record any blocked task.

simplicity.decision: Show one dominant next safe action and progressively disclose telemetry and secondary evidence.
simplicity.rationale: Compact information should remain decision-led rather than becoming a card mosaic.
verification: Review each route for one primary action and a clear disclosure hierarchy.

craft.decision: Use consistent 8 px rhythm, aligned evidence values, tabular numerals, non-color state marks, and protected critical text.
craft.rationale: Visual precision supports trust and rapid scanning in an evidence workspace.
verification: Visual review at desktop and mobile widths scores hierarchy, typography, spacing, contrast, and state consistency.

delight.decision: Use restrained, immediate state continuity and a distinctive evidence assembly metaphor without decorative loops.
delight.rationale: Delight should come from clarity and confident control, not ambient spectacle.
verification: Review press, stage, inspector, and recovery transitions with and without reduced motion.

delightAndFun.decision: Use satisfying stage and inspector feedback as supporting polish.
delightAndFun.rationale: Operational confidence is more important than entertainment.
verification: Manual review of feedback cadence and absence of ambient animation.

inclusivity.decision: Make all critical tasks operable across touch, keyboard, assistive technology, text scaling, appearance, and reduced motion.
inclusivity.rationale: Inclusive access is a primary quality lens for a consequential workflow.
verification: Complete accessibility and adaptation walkthroughs at every workspace stage.

innovation.decision: Express the distinctive evidence assembly line through source-to-gate custody and bounded repair.
innovation.rationale: The workflow is differentiated by inspectable custody, not unproven autonomy.
verification: Review that the first surface and inspector communicate source, gate, control, and recovery.

interaction.decision: Prioritize queue-detail-evidence continuity, explicit permission, immediate feedback, and reversible control points.
interaction.rationale: Interaction is a primary lens because the value lies in review and safe action.
verification: Run the mobile task script from empty evidence through a blocked export and safe recovery.

socialImpact.decision: Support small teams in recognizing unsupported claims and release risk without claiming measured social outcomes.
socialImpact.rationale: The supplied plan describes a plausible harm-reduction purpose but supplies no impact study.
verification: Review copy for bounded purpose language and absence of quantified impact claims.

visualsAndGraphics.decision: Use an industrial evidence workspace with coherent semantic roles, precise typography, and truthful product-surface handling.
visualsAndGraphics.rationale: Visual coherence and subject truth are mandatory even when actual product media are blocked.
verification: Score the local visual review dimensions and verify honest empty states in place of placeholder media.

purposeAndPrimaryTask.decision: Lead with current job, gate, consequence, and next action.
purposeAndPrimaryTask.rationale: The primary operational task must be unmistakable.
verification: First-viewport review on every top-level mobile destination.

firstSessionDirectness.decision: Open directly on the priority queue or honest empty start state.
firstSessionDirectness.rationale: No marketing preamble should delay the first useful surface.
verification: Open / at mobile width and verify one action reaches /workspace/evidence.

progressiveDisclosure.decision: Keep decision evidence visible and place advanced model and ROCm telemetry behind accessible disclosure.
progressiveDisclosure.rationale: This balances medium-high density with review focus.
verification: Expand and collapse telemetry using touch, keyboard, and screen reader.

agencyAndRecovery.decision: Provide cancel, back, retry, correction, and safe resume without automatic replay.
agencyAndRecovery.rationale: Users must retain control around uncertain or consequential work.
verification: Interrupt a pending control point and verify recovery to the last safe state.

responsibilityAndTrust.decision: Label supplied, required, waiting, unknown, blocked, and passed states truthfully.
responsibilityAndTrust.rationale: The static build must not imply real model or export execution.
verification: Copy audit across create, verify, and export routes.

contextContinuity.decision: Persist job capsule, stage, active artifact, inspector target, and safe return focus.
verification: Queue-detail-sheet-back interaction test.

distinctiveCoherentTheme.decision: Use the selected industrial evidence assembly theme consistently across routes.
distinctiveCoherentTheme.rationale: A coherent local identity is required without borrowing a benchmark brand.
verification: Cross-route visual review for composition, roles, borders, spacing, and type.

subjectTruth.decision: Use supplied product evidence only; otherwise show an honest blocked or empty state.
subjectTruth.rationale: No product assets were supplied for truthful final media.
verification: Asset scan and manual review confirm no remote or invented product media.

informationHierarchy.decision: Order stage, consequence, next action, evidence, and telemetry consistently.
informationHierarchy.rationale: The selected direction specifies this priority.
verification: Manual scan test at desktop and phone widths.

typographicCraft.decision: Use local system type, tabular evidence values, wrapping, and no truncation of critical facts.
typographicCraft.rationale: Source spans, hashes, model names, units, and failures must remain legible.
verification: Automated overflow check and 200% text review.

materialRestraint.decision: Use borders, contrast, and restrained safety color instead of decorative gradients or glass effects.
materialRestraint.rationale: The instrument-panel surface should communicate discipline.
verification: Visual review confirms no ambient gradient identity or ornamental card mosaic.

appearanceAdaptation.decision: Provide light, dark, and increased-contrast semantic roles.
appearanceAdaptation.rationale: System appearance must preserve focus, status, and evidence legibility.
verification: Manual appearance matrix review.

platformFit.decision: Use safe areas, dynamic viewport units, familiar web controls, and a five-destination mobile model.
platformFit.rationale: The target is iOS-class mobile web, not native iOS.
verification: Portrait/landscape browser review with dynamic chrome.

directManipulation.decision: Allow direct selection and inspection while keeping consequential actions explicit.
directManipulation.rationale: Direct manipulation helps evidence review but cannot bypass gates.
verification: Select claim/audit items and confirm inspector updates without committing an action.

immediateFeedback.decision: Provide press and state feedback within 500 ms.
immediateFeedback.rationale: Immediate acknowledgement prevents duplicate action and uncertainty.
verification: Automated interaction timing assertion.

reversibility.decision: Make non-destructive navigation reversible and consequential actions confirmable with safe recovery.
reversibility.rationale: Approval, repair, and export-state changes require deliberate control.
verification: Manual confirmation, cancel, and recovery tests.

gestureAlternatives.decision: Pair every gesture with a labeled control or numeric/step alternative.
gestureAlternatives.rationale: No critical task may depend on a custom gesture.
verification: Complete comparison and inspection without gestures.

crossInputParity.decision: Support touch, keyboard, and assistive technology for the same task set.
crossInputParity.rationale: Alternative input is a universal commitment.
verification: Full task walkthrough with each declared input mode.

purposeLinkedMotion.decision: Use motion only for feedback, continuity, and orientation.
purposeLinkedMotion.rationale: The direction limits motion intensity to 2/10.
verification: Inspect every transition and map it to a declared purpose.

interruptibility.decision: Allow state transitions to be interrupted by navigation, reduced motion, or a new safe selection.
interruptibility.rationale: Waiting and inspection must not trap the user.
verification: Interrupt transitions and verify settled state and focus.

spatialContinuity.decision: Maintain source-to-inspector and queue-to-detail relationships during short transitions.
spatialContinuity.rationale: Spatial continuity supports orientation in the recomposed mobile flow.
verification: Visual interaction review of queue, detail, and sheet transitions.

reducedMotionEquivalence.decision: Remove transitions/keyframes while preserving status text, focus, and task completion.
reducedMotionEquivalence.rationale: Reduced motion must retain equivalent information and agency.
verification: Automated media-query check and manual reduced-motion workflow.

noAmbientPerpetualMotion.decision: Use no ambient, perpetual, or infinite motion and no automatic loop beyond one iteration.
noAmbientPerpetualMotion.rationale: The contract sets maxAutomaticLoopIterations to one and the selected direction sets zero duration.
verification: Static source scan for infinite/looping animation plus runtime observation.

performanceRestraint.decision: Use CSS-only transform/opacity transitions and avoid animation-driven layout.
performanceRestraint.rationale: A native static surface should remain responsive on mobile hardware.
verification: Performance review confirms no continuous animation and no layout-thrashing transition.

automated: Validate semantic landmark and control coverage, route/state determinism, touch targets, transition durations, reduced motion, contrast, overflow, and duplicate-action guards.
Capture deterministic desktop and mobile screenshots for first-pass and final visual comparison.
Scan source for remote runtime resources, invented media, infinite motion, transition: all, and disallowed comparative or Apple claims.
manual: Score product, visual, interaction, and motion dimensions against the required 4/5 minimum evidence threshold.
Complete the mobile queue-to-evidence-to-approval-to-failure-to-recovery walkthrough with touch, keyboard, and a screen reader.
Review portrait, landscape, safe areas, browser keyboard, 200% text, light, dark, increased contrast, and reduced motion.

visualAssetPolicy: The GPT-generated constellation is a project-bound atmospheric brand asset with no product claims or UI text. It cannot substitute for rights-cleared product evidence, approved claims, real campaign assets, or interface implementation.

assetPlan.reason: One non-claim atmospheric visual was generated with the built-in GPT image path and copied into the project. Real product evidence remains missing and all claim, generation, activation, and release states continue to fail closed.
missingRequirements: One to three owner-supplied or rights-cleared JPG or PNG product images for any real product-surface preview.
One owner-supplied or rights-cleared, one-page, selectable-text product specification PDF for any real source-span and Claim Ledger evidence.

entries.truthBoundary: No text, product claim, customer data, or proprietary interface was generated.

entries.origin: High-quality deterministic resample of the generated source
entries.truthBoundary: This is an 8K delivery canvas, not a claim of native 8K model output.

autonomyLevel.rationale: A deterministic local website build needs bounded prompt chaining, code-based routing, and evaluator-optimizer preflight, while one coherent implementation agent preserves cross-route visual and state consistency. The supplied product workflow has branches and approvals, but this architecture stage has no genuinely independent research subtasks that justify multi-agent orchestration.

orchestrationPatterns.role: Sequence implementation from semantic shell, through deterministic state and route wiring, to responsive styling and evidence sealing.
orchestrationPatterns.boundary: Each step consumes only the trusted implementation context and its locally produced artifacts.

orchestrationPatterns.role: Route pathname, selected workflow stage, inspector target, and UI state through explicit JavaScript maps and finite transitions.
orchestrationPatterns.boundary: No model chooses routes, permissions, approval gates, repair limits, or release status.

orchestrationPatterns.role: Evaluate structure, route coverage, state completeness, accessibility, mobile recomposition, truth boundaries, and source integrity before implementation is accepted.
orchestrationPatterns.boundary: At most three bounded preflight passes; failed gates produce actionable local findings and never expand scope.

agentTopology.rationale: The deliverable is one tightly coupled native interface whose route model, state machine, semantic roles, and responsive behavior must remain coherent. Independent research has already been normalized into the supplied artifacts, so parallel agent ownership would add merge and consistency risk without a separable evidence task.
responsibilities: Implement the semantic route shell and deterministic client state
Apply the selected direction and local semantic design roles consistently
Build desktop and mobile recompositions, interaction states, and accessibility behavior
Run bounded preflight checks and repair only evidenced failures
Seal truthful local evidence without claiming model, API, export, or publishing execution

openSourceSelections.rationale: Semantic buttons, links, forms, tables, details, dialog-compatible patterns, and landmark elements cover this static operational surface without React or a component dependency.
openSourceSelections.verification: Confirm the generated source uses native semantic elements, contains no component-library dependency or import, and passes keyboard, touch, focus, and screen-reader manual review.

openSourceSelections.rationale: The selected direction calls for low-intensity state feedback using only transform and opacity, with no loops; CSS state transitions are sufficient.
openSourceSelections.verification: Inspect CSS for transform/opacity-only transitions at or below 550 ms, zero perpetual animation, and a prefers-reduced-motion rule that removes transitions and keyframes.

openSourceSelections.rationale: No API or server-owned data exists in this website stage, so a server-state library would create a false dependency and architecture claim.
openSourceSelections.verification: Confirm there are no fetch calls, server-state packages, network retries, or cache-invalidation claims in application source.

openSourceSelections.rationale: The bounded claim, audit, route, and evidence inventories can be rendered as native lists and semantic tables; no dense-table engine is needed.
openSourceSelections.verification: Verify local arrays render deterministic list/table views with headings, captions or labels, usable overflow handling, and no data-grid dependency.

openSourceSelections.rationale: The architecture deliberately has no backend or executable API.
openSourceSelections.verification: Confirm no server entry point, API route, runtime package, or network listener is declared by the generated site.

openSourceSelections.rationale: There is no API contract to version, lint, or expose.
openSourceSelections.verification: Confirm api-contract.json remains mode=not-applicable and the implementation does not introduce API operations or governance tooling.

architecture: All required architecture keys and enums validate locally.
Native frontend, no-backend API mode, OSS selections, and threat-model mode remain mutually consistent.
Design reference, design system, asset, category, mobile, skill, and unknown boundaries remain unchanged across handoff copies.

evaluatorChecks: semantic HTML, keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior
desktop operational canvas and mobile priority-queue recomposition
self-only resources and no unapproved dependencies or product media
preflight.optimizerBoundary: Repair only concrete evaluator failures inside the selected direction and architecture; do not add frameworks, APIs, remote media, new claims, or new product scope.

implementation: Every declared route is reachable from the local shell and has a truthful purpose-specific state.
Evidence, Brief, Create, Verify & Repair, and Export retain one coherent job context.
Approval, repair, and export-state controls disclose consequence and do not fabricate external success.
Repair allowance is capped at two and remaining failures block export.
No console errors, broken internal links, horizontal overflow at target widths, or obscured focus/control states.
No external network request, remote runtime asset, credential access, API listener, or publishing behavior.

automated: Check destination count is one to five, touch targets are at least 44 px, and transitions do not exceed 550 ms.
Check reduced-motion CSS removes transitions and keyframes and that status names remain in the accessibility tree.
Check 320, 390, 768, and landscape viewport layouts for horizontal overflow and obscured fixed controls.
Check duplicate activation guards and resume logic do not repeat consequential transitions.
manual: Walk queue, detail, evidence, approval, result, failure, and recovery with touch, keyboard, and a screen reader.
Review portrait and landscape with browser chrome, safe areas, on-screen keyboard, 200% text, light, dark, and increased contrast.
Confirm every custom gesture has a labeled alternative and every unavailable real capability remains honest.

evidence: Machine-readable validation report for JSON and source invariants
Desktop and mobile screenshots from local routes
First-pass source snapshot before evaluation and final evidence summary after bounded repair

apiContract.reason: The chosen architecture is a genuine native static/local demo with backend.mode=none. It has no executable API, mutation, external dependency, or server-owned state; adding an OpenAPI contract would fabricate implementation authority and behavior.
